intent: A queue of what agents need from you: approvals, questions, failed runs and finished recaps. Filter, mark read, and select a row to open its detail.
useWhen: collect every agent request in one place
act on approvals and questions without leaving the list
doNotUseWhen: product notifications — Toast or a notification list

items.note: { id, agentName, type: "approval" | "question" | "failure" | "recap", preview, time?, read?, approval?, question?, detail? }[]. approval renders a kit ApprovalCard, question a kit DecisionCard.

onFilterChange.note: (filter) => void. Shows the SegmentedControl with counts.

requirements: rows are buttons with aria-expanded (true on the selected row) and aria-controls on the detail region; the selected row also has aria-current
unread is said in text, not only the bold agent name
the filter is a kit SegmentedControl (radio group)
the detail region is aria-live polite
load error is role=alert with Retry
row and detail motion is opacity and transform, off under prefers-reduced-motion

doNot: Do not invent a local AgentInbox, RequestQueue, or Notification Stack for agent requests
Do not rebuild approval or question UI; items reuse ApprovalCard and DecisionCard
snippet: <AgentInbox items={items} selectedId={selected} onSelect={setSelected} filter={filter} onFilterChange={setFilter} onMarkAllRead={markAll} onApprove={approve} onDeny={deny} onAnswer={answer} />
